output.description: Leave empty to use each source folder; numeric suffixes prevent name collisions

files.dropHint: Batch images, audio and video; inspect each file before processing

options.title: Processing options

jobs.title: Job queue
jobs.description: Progress comes from FFmpeg progress pipe; cancellation and shutdown kill child processes

appUsage.title: App Usage
appUsage.desc: Real foreground sampling; pauses on idle, lock and display sleep. Audio AFK exception is not available yet.
appUsage.unavailableState: Usage counting is paused because foreground, idle, or screen-lock detection is unavailable.
appUsage.audioLimit: Limitation: system audio activity is unavailable, so playback during AFK is neither counted nor exempted.
appUsage.dailyDesc: Grouped by local date; repeated DST hours are merged
appUsage.appsDesc: Ignoring stops new time while keeping history; reversible
appUsage.settingsDesc: Saved to config.json and applied immediately

overlay.hintSmart: Click to take the highlighted window or screen · Drag to select · Wheel/Tab to change level · Esc to exit
overlay.hintManual: Drag to select · Arrows/WASD move the color probe · Esc to exit

overlay.colorHint: C copies HEX · Shift+C copies RGB
overlay.rightClickKeepsEdits: Annotations exist, right-click keeps the selection; press Esc to exit

panel.title: Screenshot & Pin
panel.subtitle: M1: frozen capture → selection → annotate → save/copy → pinned image. OCR, scrolling capture and GIF come in later milestones.

panel.noPins: No pins yet; use "Pin to screen" in the capture toolbar

cap.captureDesc: Checks permission, captures a real frozen frame, then shows the overlay; crops physical pixels so Retina sizes are exact
cap.manualDesc: Drag, 8 resize handles, arrow keys move 1px, Shift+arrows resize, hold Space to move
cap.windowRegionsDesc: Highlights the frontmost window under the cursor from the system window list (L1); wheel/Tab expands to full screen
cap.annotateDesc: Rectangle, arrow, mosaic, counter and text with undo/redo, magnifier with RGB/HEX picker
cap.pinDesc: Separate topmost window: drag, wheel zoom 10%–500%, Shift+wheel opacity, double-click to collapse, close releases memory
cap.uiElementsDesc: Accessibility tree (L2) and visual edge candidates (L3) are not connected yet; planned for M2
cap.ocrDesc: System OCR and custom ONNX models, planned for M2

guide.select: Press F1 or tray "Capture Region"; drag to select, click to take the highlighted region, right-click clears the selection, right-click again exits
guide.smart: Before selecting, wheel or Tab / Shift+Tab switches between window and full screen
guide.adjust: Arrow keys move 1 pixel, Shift+arrows resize, hold Space to drag the selection, 8 handles adjust edges
guide.export: Enter, ⌘/Ctrl+C or double-click copies; ⌘/Ctrl+S saves (never overwrites); F3 pins; Esc cancels
guide.color: The magnifier follows the cursor, WASD or arrows move one pixel; C copies HEX, Shift+C copies RGB
guide.pin: Pins: drag to move, wheel to zoom, Shift+wheel for opacity, double-click to collapse, right-click keeps the toolbar, Esc closes
